description: Implement leave state management with LeaveBloc following the AttendanceBloc pattern for employee leave overview functionality including balance display and history
steps: Define LeaveLoadRequested event for loading employee leave data
Define LeaveState with status enum (initial/loading/loaded/error), leaveBalance, leaveRequests list, and error fields
Implement LeaveBloc extending Bloc<LeaveEvent, LeaveState> with LeaveRepository dependency
Add _onLeaveLoadRequested handler calling repository methods to fetch balance and requests
Follow the same error handling and state management patterns used in AttendanceBloc
Ensure all events and states extend Equatable for proper state comparison
Add proper props overrides for Equatable implementation on all classes
acceptance_criteria: LeaveBloc follows the exact same structural patterns as AttendanceBloc
State management properly handles loading, success, and error states
BLoC correctly integrates with LeaveRepository and handles async operations
All classes properly implement Equatable for state comparison
verification: Run `flutter analyze lib/features/leaves/presentation/blocs/` and verify no compilation errors
Compare generated LeaveBloc structure with AttendanceBloc to ensure consistency
Verify BLoC can be instantiated with LeaveRepository without runtime errors
